findings.subject: NCT03905330
findings.R_source_quote: Primary Endpoint Pruritus severity in PFIC2 measured by ItchRo(Obs)
findings.R_object_value: Pruritus severity in PFIC2 measured by ItchRo(Obs)
findings.f_method: Identify which registered endpoint occupies the success-determining slot for THIS catalyst (the registered PRIMARY whose timeFrame aligns with the catalyst readout), then test whether the marketed success-basis endpoint is that one. Two axes are independent: efficacy-vs-safety (what it measures) and primary-vs-secondary (its hierarchy slot). A secondary endpoint can be a legitimate efficacy endpoint — describing one is NOT masking. Also inspect version HISTORY for a CONSTRUCT/TYPE change of the registered primary near readout.
findings.m_source: ClinicalTrials.gov registration + version history
findings.rationale: The claim states the primary endpoint is 'Pruritus severity in PFIC2 measured by ItchRo(Obs)' filed 2022-01-11. The registry's version 0 (2019-04-04) registered 'Treatment response as measured by the mean change in pruritus severity as assessed by the Observer rated Itch Reported Outcome (ItchRO [Obs])' and version 27 (2022-07-18) restated this as 'Mean change in the average morning ItchRO(Obs) severity score in the primary cohort.' Both versions measure the same construct (pruritus severity via ItchRO[Obs]) with the same timeFrame ('Between Baseline and Week 15 through 26'). The wording evolution is administrative refinement, not a construct change. The marketed endpoint is the registered primary whose timeFrame aligns with the Phase 3 catalyst.
findings.m_evidence: primary_endpoint_timeline shows version 0 primary: 'Treatment response as measured by the mean change in pruritus severity as assessed by the Observer rated Itch Reported Outcome (ItchRO [Obs])' timeFrame 'Between Baseline and Week 15 through 26'; version 27 primary: 'Mean change in the average morning ItchRO(Obs) severity score in the primary cohort.' timeFrame 'Between Baseline and Week 15 through Week 26'. Both versions measure pruritus via ItchRO(Obs) at Week 15-26.
